summary: Verified Production Library audit fixes: (1) Create Company Standard modal opens from 'New Standard' button, form validates and persists (QA-22422 created & appears in list, count 48->49); (2) Bulk Duplicate creates '-COPY' items (DW-001->DW-001-COPY, DW-002->DW-002-COPY); (3) Bulk Archive removes items from active view (2 copies disappeared after archive); (4) Assemblies/Templates/Production History/Archives nav items all show proper Coming Soon empty states in the main content area - NO toast messages fired for these nav clicks; (5) Detail page navigation verified from iteration_17 (unchanged handler navigates to /app/production-library/items/:id).

ui_bugs.issue: Assemblies nav item shows count '0' badge in sidebar even though the view is a 'Coming Soon' placeholder. Consider hiding the count for Coming Soon items or showing a dash/lock icon instead to avoid implying data exists.

'Company Standards' count in the left sidebar (e.g. 51) does not decrement immediately after bulk Archive (items are removed from the list view but the cached count stays until page reload). Local state update should also decrement `counts.standards`.

integration_issues.issue: Recurring console errors from iteration_17 still present: '[useOrganization] Error: TypeError: Failed to fetch', '[AppLayout] Workspace context error', 'Error fetching profile: TypeError: Failed to fetch'. Non-blocking - page still renders correctly, but noisy in console.

Sonner toast text was not captured by the test after Create/Duplicate/Archive actions (toast either fired and dismissed very quickly, or selector [data-sonner-toast] didn't match). The underlying actions succeeded (items appeared/disappeared as expected), but the user feedback toast should be visible for a few seconds. Worth verifying in a manual test.

action_items: LOW: Hide 'count' badge for Coming Soon nav items (Assemblies) or replace with a lock/soon indicator so users don't think there are 0 assemblies to display.
LOW: After bulk Archive in handleBulkAction, decrement counts.standards locally to keep sidebar in sync without a refetch.
LOW: Manually verify success/error Sonner toasts show for Create Standard, Bulk Duplicate, Bulk Archive (my test showed empty toast text although the actions succeeded).
LOW (recurring): Investigate '[useOrganization] TypeError: Failed to fetch' console errors on /app/production-library initial paint (present since iteration_17).
critical_code_review_comments: Login page: input[type='email'] appears to be a controlled input that occasionally does not accept Playwright's .fill() - value stays empty. Non-blocking (typing via keyboard works), but suggests the field may swallow programmatic input events. Consider adding `name='email'` and testing with password managers.

ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx is now 2156 lines and still growing (was 1900+ in iteration_17). Recommend splitting: CompanyStandardsView, DomainsView, CategoriesView, DetailPanel, CommandPalette each to their own file.

handleBulkAction 'duplicate' spreads entire item into POST body including joined fields (`knowledge_domains`, `measurement_units`, `service_categories`) which are not part of ProductionItemCreate schema - Pydantic will ignore them but backend logs may show warnings. Cleaner: whitelist only the fields the create endpoint accepts.

handleBulkAction 'archive' calls DELETE per item in parallel via Promise.all - no error toast is shown if some but not all succeed (only 'if successCount > 0' path). Users won't know if a partial failure occurred.

AssembliesView shows 'Coming Soon' even when assemblies array has content - if the future 'unlocks' assemblies, this component won't render them. Wire the count-badge and view state together to a single feature flag.

TemplatesView copy says 'Coming in Estimate Builder' which is different from the other 'COMING SOON' pill styling used by Assemblies/History/Archives - inconsistent UX (all four are unreleased features).

Recurring from iteration_17: routes/production_library.py 1900+ lines; JWT decoded with verify_signature=False; verify_token_and_get_org and get_service_headers duplicated across 3 route files. Not addressed.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% - all critical audit flows working: Create Standard modal creates+persists, Bulk Archive/Duplicate work end-to-end, Coming Soon states render for Assemblies/Templates/History/Archives (no toast placeholders)
